# Trinitas ERP — live settings
#
# Fill in the four DB_ lines from hPanel → Databases → MySQL Databases.
# Everything else can stay as it is.
#
# Keep this file private. It is stored outside public_html so the web server
# cannot serve it, and the .htaccess blocks it as a second line of defence.

APP_NAME="Trinitas ERP"
APP_ENV=production

# Generated during setup — do not edit by hand.
APP_KEY=

# Never turn this on in production: it prints database credentials and file
# paths onto the error page for anyone who triggers an exception.
APP_DEBUG=false

# Your domain, with https and no trailing slash.
APP_URL=https://yourdomain.com
FRONTEND_URL=https://yourdomain.com

APP_TIMEZONE=Asia/Manila
APP_LOCALE=en

# --- Database (hPanel → Databases → MySQL Databases) -------------------------
DB_CONNECTION=mysql
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306
DB_DATABASE=
DB_USERNAME=
DB_PASSWORD=

# --- Sessions, cache, queue --------------------------------------------------
# Database-backed so nothing depends on Redis, which shared hosting lacks.
SESSION_DRIVER=database
SESSION_LIFETIME=120
SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true
SESSION_SAME_SITE=lax

CACHE_STORE=database
QUEUE_CONNECTION=database

# --- Logging -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Daily files, kept 14 days, so the log cannot fill the hosting quota.
LOG_CHANNEL=daily
LOG_LEVEL=warning
LOG_DAILY_DAYS=14

# --- Mail --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Leave these alone. SMTP is configured inside the app at
# Admin → System Settings → Email, and stored encrypted in the database.
MAIL_MAILER=smtp

# --- Security ----------------------------------------------------------------
BCRYPT_ROUNDS=12
